name: Bluetooth (BlueZ)

1.how: bluetoothctl power on | scan on | devices | pair <mac> | trust <mac> | connect <mac> | disconnect <mac> | info <mac>; non-interactive: bluetoothctl -- connect <mac>
1.notes: Pairing needs a PIN confirmation for some devices: surface it to the user.

1.how: org.bluez on the system bus: /org/bluez/hci0 Adapter1 (StartDiscovery), Device1 objects (Connect, Pair, Trusted), PropertiesChanged

quirks: Some headsets need `trust` before `connect` to auto-reconnect.
